Executive decision summary

The RC room language is complete.

VERIFIED LOCALLY. Mission Control now reads as an asymmetric command chamber, the Passage preserves a visible power-down and builds anticipation through a converging hallway, and the Arena reads as an inhabited ceremonial room rather than a title screen followed by cards.

The existing route, state machine, fixtures, accessibility contract, and five-station information architecture were preserved.

Record boundary

No schema, migration, Prisma, API, backend, auth, Stripe, billing, legal, production flag, dependency, or architecture change.

This is the pre-deployment validation record. It neither authorizes nor reports a merge, push, deployment, promotion, migration, or database action.

Verified deployment identity and remote results belong only in the later CXOS_PHASE_5_2_VERCEL_HANDOFF.txt and CXOS_PHASE_5_2_VERCEL_HANDOFF.html.

Three surfaces, one facility

Mission Control

Instrument banks, vault, horizon, runway, side consoles, and a central chamfered aperture replace the equal-card grid. Existing fixture facts remain unchanged. Proceed and Director controls retain 44 px targets.

The Passage

The origin visibly powers down before departure. Filled planes converge toward a distant aperture, blue rectilinear geometry yields to gold arcs, and the threshold match-cuts to the settled Arena.

The Arena

A viewport-bound vault, ground, fog, shafts, motes, perimeter, colonnade, arch, and floor seal hold the room. Evidence becomes an engraved ledger; milestones become earned seals. The mobile review footer now reserves explicit clearance from the fixed Director tray and resets that clearance at sm.

Accessibility and performance

Accessibility

0Axe violations in each of 7 production-mode scenarios

Correct heading focus, working skip link, 44 px primary targets, truthful fail-safe announcement, no false modal claim, and a complete static reduced-motion projection.

Automated checks are not certification by every assistive-technology combination.

Performance

0CLS across all 7 final optimized scenarios

Functional matrix: 7 / 7 with 0 Axe violations, 0 console errors, 0 horizontal overflow, and 0 CLS; return focus and scrollY: 0 remained intact.

Comprehensive observation: depending on profile, intermittent main-thread long tasks ranged from 57–244 ms during startup and/or the Passage.

Isolated mobile-natural rerun: after stopping the gstack daemon, the observer recorded 59 ms at startup and 67 ms / 85 ms during the Passage, 211 ms total.

These observations are a current performance caveat requiring Founder review and remote confirmation. This record assigns neither a performance pass nor a hard failure. Review route: 10.7 kB route JS / 105 kB first load.

No dependency, asset, WebGL layer, canvas loop, or runtime JavaScript animation loop was added.

Production safety and risk

Branch-lineage caution

HIGH integration caution, not an RC design blocker. feat/cxos-phase3 is 58 commits ahead of origin/main; commits predating baseline 2736dea include changes outside this assignment’s allowed surface. Do not merge this branch wholesale. If approved, extract or reconcile only the reviewed RC delta after a separate production-safety review.

The pre-deployment RC delta touches CSS, five existing Passage presentation components, the Passage ledger, and its guard. The reports and current-state entry are documentation-only. There are no Prisma, migration, API, auth, Stripe, billing, legal, manifest, lockfile, or Vercel changes.

This document freezes local pre-deployment validation only. It intentionally states no RC commit, remote branch SHA, Preview URL, or deployment result; those facts belong in the later Vercel handoff artifacts after verification.

Any future integration should be one reversible presentation patch; there is no migration, environment change, dependency addition, or data rollback in this RC scope.
